{{Quote|You are a botanist, Syndic Hart?''"<br />"''No. Why?''"<br />"''I saw you looking at the Yagaran aleudrupe plants there.|Falmal and Talon Karrde|<ref name="First Contact">{{JournalCite|1|First Contact}}</ref>}}
'''Botanists''' were individuals who studied [[Plant/Legends|plants]] for medical and scientific purposes.

==Famous botanists==
The entire [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] and [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were renowned botanists. Individuals included [[Plett]], [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]], and [[Baji]].
